::: {#def-mse}
#### Mean squared error

The **population mean squared error (pMSE)** of an estimator $\hparam$,
also called its **mean squared error**, denoted
$\pMSE{\hparam}$, is the expectation of the square
of the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error):

$$\pMSE{\hparam} \eqdef \E{\sqf{\erf{\hparam}}}$$
:::
